system.description:
Ability Score Increases. +1 to Constitution and one other ability score.

Tool Proficiency. Cook’s utensils.

Skill Proficiencies. Culture and either Nature or Survival.

Suggested Equipment (cost 4 gp). Cook’s utensils, common clothes, mess tin, 1 dagger.

Feature: Home-Cooked Meal. Your food is as comforting as it is nourishing, even while you’re on the road. When you or your allies expend Hit Dice as part of a short rest, you each heal 1 additional Hit Die.

Adventures and Advancement: Help in the Kitchen. As you expand your culinary repertoire, people begin to seek you out, hoping to score a taste of one of your marvelous dishes. Some may ask you about your prep techniques, your knife skills—or what your secret ingredient might be. Once your celebrity has reached its peak, you gain the service of two inexperienced cooks who act as your sous chefs.

Connection and Memento. Roll 1d10, choose, or make up your own.
